scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
Welcome to the
Einbroch Airport,
where we offer nonstop
flights to the cities of
Juno, Lighthalzen and Hugel.
scripts.translation:
[机场工作人员]
欢迎来到艾音布罗克机场，
我们提供飞往朱诺、里希塔乐镇和毁葛的不间断航班。

scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
The Airship boarding fee
is 1,200 zeny, but if you've
got a Free Ticket for Airship,
the fee will be waived. Will
you board the Airship?
scripts.translation:
[机场工作人员]
飞空艇的登船费是1,200 Zeny，
但如果您持有飞空艇免费票，
则无需支付费用。
您要登上飞空艇吗？

scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have a Free Ticket for
Airship and you don't have
enough zeny for boarding
the Airship. Remember, the
boarding fee is 1,200 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[机场工作人员]
很抱歉，您没有飞空艇免费票，
且Zeny不足以支付登船费。
请记住，登船费是1,200 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
Thank you and
have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[机场工作人员]
谢谢，祝您有美好的一天。

scripts.text:
[Arrival Staff]
Welcome to Einbroch Airport.
If you are arriving from your
flight, let me guide you to the
main terminal. Otherwise, please board the Airship to depart to
Juno, Lighthalzen and Hugel.
scripts.translation:
[到达区工作人员]
欢迎来到艾音布罗克机场。
如果您是刚下飞机的旅客，
请让我带您前往主航站楼。
否则，请登上飞空艇前往朱诺、里希塔乐镇或毁葛。

scripts.text:
[Arrival Staff]
Once you're in the main terminal, you will need to pay the fee again
to board an Airship. You should
only exit if the city of Einbroch
is your intended destination.
Proceed to the main terminal?
scripts.translation:
[到达区工作人员]
一旦进入主航站楼，
您若再次登上飞空艇，
将需要重新支付费用。
只有当艾音布罗克是您的目的地时，
才应该离开。
要前往主航站楼吗？

scripts.text:
[Arrival Staff]
Alright, thank you
for your patronage
and I hope you have
a pleasant flight~
scripts.translation:
[到达区工作人员]
好的，感谢您的惠顾，
祝您旅途愉快~

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Welcome to the
Einbroch Airport.
Please use this door to
board the Airship which stops
over Juno, Lighthalzen and
Hugel in the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
欢迎来到艾音布罗克机场。
请通过这扇门登上飞空艇，
它将飞往修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的
朱诺、里希塔乐镇和毁葛。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
Otherwise, if Einbroch is
your intended destination,
please head down the stairs
and ask the Arrival Staff to lead
you to the main terminal. Thank
you, and enjoy your travels.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
否则，如果艾音布罗克是您的目的地，
请走下楼梯，
并询问到达区工作人员带您前往主航站楼。
谢谢，祝您旅途愉快。
